evals.name: Mandatory 6-File Compose Topology Scaffolding
evals.prompt: Scaffold a multi-environment Docker Compose architecture supporting local development hot-reloading, standalone production, shared infrastructure, and zero-VPS remote image deployment.
evals.expected_output: Creates all 6 modular compose files (base, override, prod, shared, existing-infra, repo) adhering to separation of concerns.
assertions: Defines base docker-compose.yml with application container and internal bridge network
Generates docker-compose.override.yml with development volume bind mounts
Configures docker-compose.existing-infra.yml attaching to external database networks
Provides docker-compose.repo.yml for pulling pre-built registry images without compilation

evals.name: Dynamic Port Mapping & Zero-Hardcoded Secrets
evals.prompt: Configure service port mappings and database credentials across Docker Compose files while eliminating hardcoded passwords and static ports.
evals.expected_output: Interpolates host ports dynamically using ${HOST_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}} and binds secrets exclusively via environment variables.
assertions: Interpolates database passwords and JWT secrets from environment variables
Avoids plain-text credentials in version-controlled compose files
Provides sensible fallback values for non-sensitive configuration parameters

evals.name: Condition-Based Healthcheck Dependency Sequencing
evals.prompt: Configure dependent application containers to wait for PostgreSQL and Redis to become fully operational before starting execution.
evals.expected_output: Defines healthchecks for stateful services and configures depends_on with condition: service_healthy.
assertions: Implements pg_isready healthcheck for PostgreSQL service
Implements redis-cli ping healthcheck for Redis service
Configures depends_on using condition: service_healthy on application service
Specifies interval, timeout, retries, and start_period health parameters
